title: red-pipeline becomes intake's CI detector
goal: The main-pipeline check of backlog.py red-pipeline (job-level, after BG-meuqnbjg) runs as one intake detector with the same fingerprint and links, so an intake run and red-pipeline file the same one bug; red-pipeline and red-pipeline --status stay as commands with unchanged output and exit codes; with every job manual a pipeline no one started is green and files nothing
